title: Delivery and Acceptance of Units under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Delivery and Acceptance — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

## Terms

(a) **Signer.** Acceptance takes effect only when a named authorized signer has completed the delivery acceptance request for the unit. The evidence is the system record of that request — its type and its status — not a statement that it was signed.

(b) **Period.** The delivery and acceptance certificate must be signed no later than the tier's delivery acceptance period (in calendar days) after the unit was delivered. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the delivery date recorded on the unit, and signing on the last day is timely.

(c) **Unaccepted unit.** A unit not accepted within the period stays ordered and the dealer is not paid until the business either accepts it or rejects it in writing.

## The period in parts

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the unit's recorded delivery date (day zero) |
| Counting | calendar days, the first counted day being the day after delivery |
| Length | the tier's delivery acceptance period |
| Comparison | signing no later than the last day of the period |
| Last day itself | timely |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, with a period of 5 calendar days)

| Delivery date | Signed on | Days counted | Timely? |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 0 | day 5 | 5 | Yes — the last day of the period |
| day 0 | day 6 | 6 | No — the unit stays ordered and the dealer is not paid until the business accepts or rejects in writing |

## Points of judgement

- A request completed by someone who is not a named authorized signer does not make acceptance take effect.
- The acceptance request must be the one for this unit; a completed request for another unit of the same Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease master agreement does not count.
